The '''Corellian Sector Force''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]], assigned to the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Like the other Sector Force, it was created from the local resistance movement: the [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]]. It was one of the most powerful Sector Force of the Rebellion and one of the most active in the early years of the conflict. Like the [[Bothan Sector Force]], the Corellian Sector Force was known for remaining relatively independent of [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> It was likely the basis of [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement]].
